data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google ML Kit Pose Detection on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that uses Google's ML Kit Pose Detection to detect the pose of a subject's body in real time from a continuous video or static image. It acts as a bridge to native platform APIs via platform channels.
use_when: You need real-time body pose detection in a mobile app.
You want to leverage Google's on-device ML Kit pose detection capabilities.
avoid_when: You need web or desktop platform support.
You want a pure Dart implementation without native platform dependencies.
strengths: Uses Google's native ML Kit for performance.
Supports both stream and single image detection modes.
weaknesses: Limited to mobile platforms (Android and iOS).
Running pose detection inference on iOS simulator requires a physical device due to GPU/Metal requirements.
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum iOS deployment target of 15.0, Xcode 15.3.0+, Swift 5.9, adding linker flags (-ObjC, -all_load), downloading and adding ML Kit resource bundles to Xcode Runner target, and setting Android minSdkVersion 21 and compileSdkVersion 36.
